## Libraries and Utility Functions

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
  # required libraries
  library(tidyverse)
  library(flextable)
  library(ggh4x)

  # set chunk defaults
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 6.0, dpi = 600, comment = NA)

  # utility function to compute mean value and estimate its confidence interval from bootstrapping, allowing for NA values
  mean_ci <- function(vec, n_boot = 10000, alpha = 0.01, digits = 2) {
    v <- vec[!is.na(vec)]
    n <- length(v)
    b <- numeric(n_boot)
    for (i in 1:n_boot) {
      b[i] <- mean(v[sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)])
    }
    return(sprintf("%.*f [%.*f; %.*f]", digits, mean(v), digits, quantile(b, 0.5 * alpha), digits, quantile(b, 1.0 - 0.5 * alpha)))
  }

  # utility function to compute root mean squared value and estimate with confidence interval from bootstrapping, allowing for NA values
  rmsq_ci <- function(vec, n_boot = 10000, alpha = 0.01, digits = 2) {
    v <- vec[!is.na(vec)]
    n <- length(v)
    b <- numeric(n_boot)
    for (i in 1:n_boot) {
      b[i] <- sqrt(mean(v[sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)]^2))
    }
    return(sprintf("%.*f [%.*f; %.*f]", digits, sqrt(mean(v*v)), digits, quantile(b, 0.5 * alpha), digits, quantile(b, 1.0 - 0.5 * alpha)))
  }

  # utility function to plot in high resolution to *.png and *.pdf file and inline (using R markdown syntax)
  plot_pdf_png <- function(file_name, aspect_ratio, plot_object, plot_width = 6.0, plot_res = 600) {
    themed_object <- plot_object + theme(text = element_text(size = 10), plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
    pdf(sprintf("%s.pdf", file_name), width = plot_width, height = plot_width * aspect_ratio, paper = "a4");                 print(themed_object); ignore <- dev.off()
    png(sprintf("%s.png", file_name), width = plot_width, height = plot_width * aspect_ratio, units = "in", res = plot_res); print(themed_object); ignore <- dev.off()
    cat(sprintf("![](%s.png)\n", file_name))
  }
```

## Data Postprocessing

```{r postprocessing, results = "asis"}
  # load data generation and data analysis results, plot cost distribution (across all runs), note that ggplot stacks after log-transformation, which is discouraged (and wrong)
  load("./DataGeneration.Rdata")
  load("./DataAnalysis.Rdata")

  plot_pdf_png("Figure_S1", 0.7, plot_width = 10,
    study_pops %>% filter(costs > 0) %>% mutate(events = factor(events)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = costs, group = events, fill = events)) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 1000.0) + theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) + scale_x_continuous(labels = ~sprintf("%.0f", .x), limits = c(0.0, 130000.0)) +
      labs(x = "Non-Zero Costs [Euro]", y = "Absolute Frequency", fill = "# Events") + facet_wrap(~study_group))

  # check maximum cumulative length of stay, should not exceed follow-up period
  print(sprintf("Maximum cumulative length of stay found in simulated data: %d days, should be less than %d days (%s)", max(study_pops$cumlos), 365, max(study_pops$cumlos) < 365))

  # report proprortion of participants without events
  study_pops %>% group_by(study_group) %>% reframe(zero_event = sprintf("%.01f%%", 100.0 * sum(events == 0) / n())) %>% flextable() %>% set_caption("Proportion without events") %>% autofit()

  # loop over analyses (regression model specifications)
  for (m in 1:length(regression_models)) {
    m_name <- names(regression_models)[m]
    print(paste(m_name, regression_models[m], sep = ": "))
    res <- results %>% filter(f == regression_models[m]) %>% select(-f)

    # analyze robustness of different regression function implementations (already summed in data analysis across Gaussian log and Gamma models)
    res %>% filter(grepl("Two-Stage", model)) %>% select(N, returned, converged, valid_RSS, best_RSS) %>% separate_wider_delim(!N, delim = "/", names_sep = "") %>%
      group_by(N) %>% reframe(across(everything(), ~sum(as.integer(.x)))) %>% pivot_longer(!N, names_to = "Status") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = N, values_from = value) %>%
      mutate(Model  = factor(str_replace_all(Status, c("[a-zA-Z_]*" = "")), levels = 1:4, labels = c("glm+start", "glm2+start", "gam", "glmmTMB+start"))) %>%
      mutate(Status = factor(str_replace_all(Status, c("[0-9]*"     = "")), levels = c("returned", "converged", "valid_RSS", "best_RSS"))) %>%
      select(Model, Status, everything()) %>% arrange(Model, Status) %>% mutate(Status = str_replace(Status, "best_RSS", "(co-)optimum")) %>%
      flextable() %>%
        set_caption(sprintf("Table S1 (%s): Convergence of Gauss(log) and Gamma regressions (perfect = %d)", m_name, 6 * n_sim)) %>%
        autofit() %>% hline(c(4, 8, 12)) %>% align(j = -2:-1, align = "right", part = "body") %>% flextable_to_rmd()

    # ensure reproducibility / comparability between regression models (bootstrapping)
    set.seed(314159)

    # subtract true population effects (theta), by study group, compute cost difference, Bias and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) (serial execution, to avoid potential issues with random number generators)
    res  <- res %>% select(-returned, -converged, -valid_RSS, -best_RSS) %>% mutate(costdiff = costdiff - true_cost$difference)
    bias <- res %>% mutate(model = fct_inorder(model)) %>% group_by(N, model) %>% reframe(across(everything(), ~mean_ci(    .x)))  %>% mutate(Metric = "Bias")
    mae  <- res %>% mutate(model = fct_inorder(model)) %>% group_by(N, model) %>% reframe(across(everything(), ~mean_ci(abs(.x)))) %>% mutate(Metric = "MAE")
    rmse <- res %>% mutate(model = fct_inorder(model)) %>% group_by(N, model) %>% reframe(across(everything(), ~rmsq_ci(    .x)))  %>% mutate(Metric = "RMSE")
    results_all <- rbind(bias, mae, rmse)
    results_all %>% select(Metric, N, model, costdiff)   %>% arrange(Metric, N) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = costdiff) %>%
      flextable() %>% set_caption(sprintf("Table S2 (%s, Cost Difference): Bias, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) in EUR with 99%%-CIs, %d simulation runs", m_name, n_sim)) %>%
        autofit() %>% align(j = -1, align = "center", part = "header") %>% align(j = -1, align = "right", part = "body") %>% hline(i = c(4, 8)) %>% flextable_to_rmd()

    # summary figures, main results for bias, mean absolute error, and root mean squared error, for the difference in cost
    plot_pdf_png(sprintf("Figure_1_%s", m_name), 1.0,
      results_all %>% select(Metric, N, model, costdiff) %>% mutate(Metric = fct_inorder(Metric)) %>% mutate(mean = as.double(gsub(" .*", "", costdiff))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = N, y = mean, color = model, shape = model)) +
        geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = unique(res$N)) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(1:2, 5:6, 3:4, 7:8)) +
        labs(x = "Study population size (N)", y = "Errors [EUR]", color = "", shape = "") +
        theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.title.position = "top", legend.byrow = TRUE) +
        facet_grid2(vars(), vars(Metric), scales = "free_y", independent = "y") +
        facetted_pos_scales(y = list(Metric == "MAE"  ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(100.0, 560.0), trans = "log10", breaks = c(100, 140, 200, 280, 400, 560)),
                                     Metric == "RMSE" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(100.0, 560.0), trans = "log10", breaks = c(100, 140, 200, 280, 400, 560)))))

    # quantile-quantile plot for errors (theta_i - theta), for the difference in cost
    plot_pdf_png(sprintf("Figure_S4_%s", m_name), 1.0,
      res %>% select(N, model, costdiff) %>% mutate(model = fct_inorder(model)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(sample = costdiff, color = model, shape = model)) +
        stat_qq_line() + stat_qq(size = 0.5) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.5, 3.5), breaks = -3:3) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2500.0, 2500.0)) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(1:2, 5:6, 3:4, 7:8)) +
        labs(y = "Observed errors [EUR]", x = "Theoretical distribution of errors [standard deviations]", color = "", shape = "") +
        theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.title.position = "top", legend.byrow = TRUE) + facet_wrap(~N))

    # scatter plot of errors (theta_i - theta) across all simulation runs, for each pair of analysis methods, maximum study size
    errors <- res %>% filter(N == max(N)) %>% select(costdiff, model, N)  %>% mutate(run = rep(1:n_sim, each = length(unique(res$model)))) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = costdiff) %>% select(-run, -N)
    pairwise  <- data.frame()
    for (i in 2:length(names(errors))) {
      for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
        pairwise <- rbind(pairwise, data.frame(x = errors[,i], y = errors[,j], names(errors)[i], names(errors)[j]) %>% setNames(c("x", "y", "nx", "ny")))
      }
    }
    plot_pdf_png(sprintf("Figure_S5_%s", m_name), 1.0,
      pairwise %>% mutate(nx = fct_inorder(nx), ny = fct_inorder(ny)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_point(size = 0.1) + labs(x = "Errors [EUR]", y = "Errors [EUR]") +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-600, 600), breaks = seq(-400, 400, 400)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-600, 600), breaks = seq(-400, 400, 400)) + facet_grid(vars(nx), vars(ny)))
  }
```
